findings.title: API key must be sent as a header
findings.documented: API key requirement differs from the actual request requirement.
findings.actual: The API requires the key in the X-API-Key request header.
findings.how_found: A request using a query parameter failed, while X-API-Key succeeded.
findings.impact: Authentication fails unless the API key is sent using the required header.

findings.title: Login response differs from documentation
findings.documented: Documentation describes a different token format and lifetime.
findings.actual: Login returns access_token, refresh_token, token_type and expires_in. The access token expires after 900 seconds.
findings.impact: The application must use the actual access-token and refresh-token flow.

findings.title: Listings pagination uses offset, not page
findings.actual: Listings are paginated using offset and limit. Changing page did not change results, while offset did.
findings.how_found: Compared requests using different page and offset values.

findings.title: Reported listing total is incorrect
findings.documented: The listings response provides a total field.
findings.actual: The API reported total 3236, but 3500 distinct records were retrieved.
findings.how_found: Downloaded all batches using offset pagination and counted unique listing IDs.
findings.impact: The total field cannot be trusted for determining dataset completeness.

findings.title: Project prices use inconsistent units/scales
findings.documented: Project prices are represented as numeric values.
findings.actual: Project prices use mixed lakh/crore-style scales rather than one consistent INR scale.
findings.how_found: Compared price_min and price_max values across project records.
findings.impact: Prices must be normalized before comparing projects.

findings.title: Project total_listings is inconsistent
findings.actual: 295 projects have a total_listings value different from the actual listing count by project_id.
findings.how_found: Grouped all listing records by project_id and compared the counts.
findings.impact: total_listings should not be treated as the authoritative listing count.

findings.title: Some listing records contain impossible values
findings.documented: Listings contain numeric property attributes such as price, floor and area.
findings.how_found: Checked for negative prices/areas, floor greater than total floors, and carpet area greater than super built-up area.
findings.impact: These records should be excluded from calculations requiring valid property data.

findings.title: Strong fake-listing indicators exist in seller data
findings.documented: Seller contact and seller name fields are provided.
findings.actual: 12 seller contacts are associated with at least 10 listings and at least 3 different seller names, covering 230 listings.
findings.how_found: Grouped listings by seller contact and checked for high-volume contacts with multiple seller identities.
findings.impact: These 230 records were treated as fake-listing candidates for the required analysis.
